_comment: Railway service config for the daily KDP publisher. Use with Dockerfile.kdp. Create as a SEPARATE service from the FastAPI app.

deploy._restart_comment: Cron jobs should not auto-restart on success/failure — Railway re-invokes on the next schedule tick.
